methodology.scope: All runtime scripts referenced by index.html at REFRACTOR_BASELINE.
methodology.reads: Deterministic lexical cross-reference against top-level declarations after removing comments and string literals. Dynamic name construction and property-level aliasing still require runtime tracing.
methodology.writes: Top-level mutable bindings, explicit globalThis/window overrides, and state.* for files known to mutate the shared match object. Property-level writes are summarized rather than enumerated.
methodology.publishes: Top-level function/class/const/let/var names plus explicit globalThis/window assignments. In classic scripts these form the effective shared namespace even when not intentionally public.
methodology.existingTests: Direct filename/path references in tests/*.js, tests/*.py and tests/*.html; behavioural transitive coverage is documented separately in AR_AC1_TEST_COVERAGE_MAP.md.
methodology.caveat: This is a static architecture inventory, not a proof that every named dependency executes on every path.
